basic.title: Basic Information
basic.description: Manage your administrator name and avatar.
basic.nameDescription: Manage your administrator name. Click the avatar on the left to change it.
basic.name: Name
basic.nameTooLong: The name must not exceed 120 characters
basic.nameInvalid: Please enter a valid name of up to 120 characters
basic.avatarPlaceholder: Choose a default avatar or upload an image
basic.avatarHelp: JPG, PNG or WebP up to 2 MB. A square image works best.
basic.avatarSizeError: The avatar file must not exceed 2 MB

password.title: Change Password
password.description: Update your password regularly to protect your administrator account.
password.newPlaceholder: At least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numbers
password.newPlaceholderStrong: At least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, and numbers
password.requirements: The password does not meet the current system password policy

security.title: Account Security
security.description: Review your current sign-in and manage sessions on other devices.
security.twoFactorDescription: When enabled, a Google authentication code is required after the password is accepted. The setup QR code appears on the first sign-in.
security.twoFactorEnabledPending: Enabled. Sign out and sign in again to set up Google Authenticator.
security.twoFactorDisableDescription: Enter the current Google Authenticator code to confirm.
security.passwordNote: Changing your password requires the current password and revokes every token except the current session.
security.mfaNote: Google two-factor secrets are encrypted. Disabling a configured authenticator requires its current code.
